gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
You should cut down ___ sugar if you want to lose weight.
gaps.explanation: cut down ON something = reduce it; cut out = eliminate completely.

gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: Her honesty more than makes ___ for her lack of experience.
gaps.explanation: 'Make up for' = compensate for a shortcoming.

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.
